description: door frame assembly machine MH2210 from Shang Rui Machinery. max. combination size 1220×2440mm, hydraulic motor power 2.2kW, weight Approx. 2000kgAssembles and glues door frames and window frames in one clamping cycle, for door and window factories. Supplied by Shang Rui Machinery with CE certification on core models, technical support and lifetime spare parts availability.

faq.q: What frame size can the Door Frame Assembly Machine MH2210 assemble?
faq.a: Maximum combination size is 1220×2440mm, covering standard door and window frame formats.
This model is double-sided, with 4 Pcs front pressing cylinders and 3 Pcs side pressing cylinders, so a frame is glued and pressed in one cycle.

faq.q: Do I need a separate gluing machine?
faq.a: A material pressing frame is included, so the glue application and pressing stage can be handled as one operation on this machine.
CE certification is available for this machine from Shang Rui Machinery, together with installation and training support.
